source_registry_summary.disclaimer_zh: 参与者自评来源等级不等于组织方核准。正式论证仅使用已与组织方DATA-SRC编号建立映射且核准状态为usable_for_formal=yes的来源。未映射来源统一降级为背景/待核验，不支撑定量结论。
source_registry_summary.disclaimer_en: Participant self-assessed source grades are not equivalent to organizer approval. Only sources mapped to organizer DATA-SRC IDs with usable_for_formal=yes are used for formal argumentation. Unmapped sources are downgraded to background/pending-verification and do not support quantitative conclusions.

source_usage_summary_zh: 本方案来源按核准状态分为三类：（1）正式核准来源（自评15项）：官方政策/法规/标准/规划/公告/任务书，用于正式论证与指标支撑；（2）参考性来源（4项）：学术论文/研究报告/案例，用于理论阐述与设计启发；（3）未核准来源（1项）：自主调研空间数据，仅作设计参考。正式论证仅使用第1类来源，最终核准以组织方source_registry为准。
source_usage_summary_en: Sources are classified by approval status: (1) Self-assessed approved sources (15 items): official policies/regulations/standards/plans/announcements/taskbook, used for formal argumentation; (2) Reference-only sources (4 items): academic papers/research reports/case studies, for theoretical support; (3) Unverified sources (1 item): team independent spatial data, design reference only. Formal argumentation uses only Category 1. Final approval subject to organizer source_registry.

usage_policy.approved_sources: 可用于正式论证和量化声明
usage_policy.needs_review_sources: 仅可用于背景描述，需标注"待核验"
usage_policy.provisional_sources: 仅可用于概念方向探讨，需标注"初步"
usage_policy.background_sources: 仅可用于背景补充，不可作为核心论据
usage_policy.disclaimer: 所有来源引用的解释权归方案团队，组织方核准结果以source_registry_summary为准
